criteria.reason: The exercise overflow menu includes a Skip Exercise option during workout logging.
Selecting skip toggles it immediately; no confirmation prompt is shown.
The finish handler creates or updates each exercise set with status "skipped" when the exercise is skipped.
Skipped exercises show an Exercise Skipped label, and partially completed exercises have a separate label.
The menu toggles between Skip Exercise and Undo Skip Exercise during the session.
The existing finish endpoint handles skipped exercises.
The diff contains no new server test for skip or unskip.
The diff contains no new client test for the skip UI.
The harness reports all existing server and client tests passing.
The added UI copy uses direct language and contains no exclamation marks.
